_kind: reconciliation baseline for the discover capability (draft); hand-derived and machine-checked from the named sources; NOT an engine receipt and NOT discover output
_honesty_boundary: discover discovers candidate state symmetries only under the fixed caliber (event names pinned).  Action-renaming symmetries (explicit or relabel caliber) stay author-declared; the machine does not guess them and this baseline does not record them as discover targets.  A fixed-pass declared group must be contained in the discovered group; a fixed-reject declared group must not be fully contained.

sealed_truth.method: brute force over S_8 (8! <= 40320), cross-validated by networkx VF2 and a fresh backtracking enumerator

sources.baseline_method: declared group elements machine-verified against the fixed criterion directly on the model; free class and per-action (prob, reward) signatures computed directly from the model; no discover output read

fixed_automorphism_expectation.order_exact_basis: sealed truth (brute-force/VF2/backtracker cross-validated in the field-trial blind-test project)
fixed_automorphism_expectation.order_lower_bound_basis: Sym(free class) <= Aut_fixed: all 1 member(s) have uniform isolated rows (machine-checked); bound tight here
fixed_automorphism_expectation.wl_note: complement states have pairwise-distinct per-action (prob, reward) signatures and the free class is a singleton, so the refinement is expected to be discrete (identity group only when the free class is empty or a single state pinned by in-edges)

automorphism_cap_default_2000.on_hit: stop enumeration, report orbit lower bound from the enumerated subset plus the WL upper bound; the exact order stays pinned by the sources above

reconciliation_checks: order: discovered order (exact, or cap lower bound plus WL upper bound) consistent with order_exact / order_lower_bound above
admission: every fixed-pass declared group contained in the discovered group; every fixed-reject declared group not fully contained
orbits: free class forms a single orbit; orbit count consistent with expected_state_orbits_if_order_exact when the order is exact
discreteness: wl_refinement_expected_discrete must match the discover refinement report
cap: automorphism_cap hit flag consistent with the expectation recorded above
